description: CLK0 (6m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass filter and a 10 dB attenuator
notes: At 8 mA the carrier reaches the analyser at about -16 dBm, above the -25 dBm where its front end distorts. Use 2 mA or more attenuation for the spur and close-in tests (the run refuses otherwise unless --force).
